notes: An older isolated probe process is sampled before replacement. PID 14378 is the new GPU development run. Sampled malloc live bytes are not PSS or Java/native mallinfo allocation peaks. Earlier dump-at-max plus continuous trace had 221 malformed-packet errors and is rejected as acceptance evidence.

health.sql: SELECT name,severity,value FROM stats WHERE (severity='error' OR severity='data_loss') AND value>0

live.sql: WITH d AS (SELECT upid,ts,SUM(size) AS delta FROM heap_profile_allocation GROUP BY upid,ts), s AS (SELECT upid,ts,SUM(delta) OVER(PARTITION BY upid ORDER BY ts) AS live FROM d) SELECT p.pid,COUNT(*) AS snapshots,MAX(live) AS sampled_max_live_bytes,MIN(ts) AS first_ts,MAX(ts) AS last_ts FROM s JOIN process p USING(upid) GROUP BY p.pid
